factual_extraction: A GNWT wildlife-management publication contains a dated, georeferenced regional map at printed scale 1:400,000.
The map associates the main shapes of the three selected polygons with named northern lakes and depicts additional named waters next to their narrower extensions.
This is a regional cartographic naming observation, not a naming-order record or an exact digital shoreline authority.
locator: PDF page 2; map date 2018-12-18; whole-feature overlays use all original baseline polygon coordinates.
